# Verified Lot Exchange

> VLE connects brands and ingredient suppliers around specific lots. Public pages describe supplier listings, lot evidence, and how the exchange works.

Public listings and supplier-reported documents do not by themselves establish certification. A laboratory result is not a certification. TEST examples remain distinct from production credentials. Current status, scope, issuer and source matter when interpreting evidence.

Private workspaces, reports and results require the account owner's authorization. This public guide grants no access and contains no private records.

## Public guide

- [Home](https://vle.exchange/): The ingredient exchange.
- [About VLE](https://vle.exchange/about): What the exchange does.
- [How it works](https://vle.exchange/how-it-works): The sourcing process.
- [Sourcing boundaries](https://vle.exchange/boundaries): What evidence and exchange activity establish.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://vle.exchange/faq): Public questions and answers.
- [Ingredient suppliers](https://vle.exchange/suppliers): Public supplier and documented lot listings.
- [Kasandrinos](https://vle.exchange/suppliers/kasandrinos): Public supplier information and lot evidence.
